options.content:
## Websites · backends · traffic · revenue · logs
Private operations dashboard. Public HTTP checks run every minute. Host and backend checks run every minute. Provider statistics refresh every 5–15 minutes. **Unknown, missing permissions and prelaunch services remain visible.** A configured dependency is not a successful customer journey. [Operating standards and runbooks](https://github.com/mithudso/llms-explorer/blob/main/docs/operations/observability.md)

targets.expr: count(fleet_check_expected unless on(project, service, kind, phase) fleet_check_success) or vector(0)

panels.title: Independent off-host checks
panels.description: A Cloudflare cron probes nine public and origin endpoints independently of the Mac. Its D1 history remains available when the Mac is offline. External paging still needs a chosen destination.

panels.title: Independent check age
panels.description: Stale checks are unknown. This is observation age, not response latency.

panels.title: Public website checks
panels.description: Unauthenticated checks. Access redirects and challenges fail; prelaunch sites remain listed. These checks do not create accounts, orders or trades.

panels.title: Observed website availability
panels.description: Only observed samples; gaps are unknown. History starts at installation. Never interpret this as complete 24-hour coverage until a full day has been collected.

panels.title: Backends, database queries, origins and processes
panels.description: The kind label distinguishes liveness, readiness, configuration, process and read-only journeys. A process/configuration PASS does not prove business functionality.

panels.title: Launch flags (enabled / disabled)
panels.description: Flags are configuration, not a payment, trading or other functional test. Disabled launch gates are preserved.

panels.title: Worker errors / previous 5 minutes
panels.description: Provider window gauges. Do not apply rate() or sum values over time. Empty provider data remains unknown.

panels.title: Provider data age
panels.description: Age of last successful acquisition, not the reporting period. Check reporting period and whether data rows exist separately.

panels.title: Google Analytics page views · yesterday
panels.description: Hostname-filtered GA4 data in the property's reporting timezone. Consent and blockers limit collection. Google and Cloudflare numbers use different definitions.

panels.title: Google Analytics active users · yesterday
panels.description: Do not sum distinct users across hostnames/properties.

panels.title: Cloudflare requests · yesterday UTC
panels.description: All requests, including bots and monitors; not human page views. Empty provider rows are not reported as zero.

options.content:
### Publisher earnings
AdSense requires its own read-only OAuth grant; Analytics read access does not include AdSense. Missing earnings are **unknown, not $0**. Amounts are estimated, per provider and currency. They are not finalized payouts. EZMob reporting needs its own authorized export/API. No ad clicks or impressions are generated by these checks.

panels.title: Backend coverage and remaining gaps
panels.description: A complete list of discovered dependencies. gap-* entries need an actual heartbeat, readiness or synthetic journey before functional coverage can be claimed.

panels.title: Central logs
panels.description: Structured monitoring events are collected now. Application log migration is tracked in coverage. Unreviewed historical application logs are not ingested.

panels.title: Active alerts
panels.description: Prometheus rules run locally. External notifications require an explicitly configured destination; an off-host watchdog remains necessary for Mac/network failure.
